utterance: Set up an AWS IAM role designed for EKS Fargate profiles in this account: a role with the name attribute set to "eks-fargate-profile-example" and an assume role policy that allows actions from 'eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com'. Also, attach the AWS managed Amazon EKS Fargate Pod Execution Role Policy (AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy) to this role.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: the account holds one IAM role named eks-fargate-profile-example, which did not exist at the start, and when the work is finished that role is trusted by eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com to assume it and carries the AWS managed AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy
